breaking.title: Haunted Mansion reopens today with original 1971 color scheme restored
breaking.body: The exterior work on Magic Kingdom's Haunted Mansion wrapped overnight. The attraction now displays its opening-day palette after a multi-week restoration project.

parkioInsight.text: The reopening tends to draw curious guests throughout the day. Visiting before 11am or after 7pm usually offers shorter waits, as midday crowds often swell with first-time viewers.

bignews.title: Jeff Vahle completes 36-year Disney career, final day as Walt Disney World president
bignews.body: Vahle's tenure ended yesterday after announcing his retirement earlier this summer. Disney has not yet named a successor to lead the Florida resort.

parkioInsight.text: Leadership transitions rarely affect day-to-day park operations. Guests should see no immediate service changes, though long-term strategy may shift over the coming months.

bignews.title: World Princess Week treats arrive August 18 across Walt Disney World
bignews.body: Disney confirmed a dozen princess-themed snacks launching mid-month at Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, Hollywood Studios, and resort locations. The collection includes items inspired by Rapunzel, Tiana, and other characters.

parkioInsight.text: Limited-time treats often sell out by early afternoon at flagship quick-service spots. Visiting locations like Gaston's Tavern or Sunshine Seasons before noon typically improves availability.

bignews.title: Bakari the silverback gorilla settling into Animal Kingdom's Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail
bignews.body: The 21-year-old male western lowland gorilla is gradually taking his role as leader of the park's family troop. Disney describes the arrival as a milestone for the animal care program.

parkioInsight.text: Gorilla Falls tends to be quieter during the late morning and early afternoon heat. Visiting around 10am or 2pm often allows closer viewing with smaller groups of guests.

topstories.title: Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party unveils darker cast member costumes for 2026
topstories.body: Party staff will wear new black uniforms starting August 7, a departure from previous years' festive orange and purple. Social media reaction has been mixed, with some guests calling the look less celebratory.

parkioInsight.text: Costume changes do not impact party content or value. Guests attending for treats, character meets, and entertainment should see no difference in their experience.

topstories.title: Annual Passholder exclusive merchandise confirmed for Halloween party dates
topstories.body: Disney revealed a black shirt with passholder branding available only during Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party. The item joins other AP-only offerings at the seasonal event.

parkioInsight.text: Exclusive party merchandise often sells out within the first few event nights. Passholders attending early dates typically have the widest size selection at Big Top Souvenirs and Emporium.

topstories.title: Disneyland adds nine attraction refurbishments to fall schedule
topstories.body: The park updated its closure calendar with projects beginning after summer season ends. Multiple rides across both Disneyland and California Adventure will close for maintenance in the coming months.

parkioInsight.text: Offseason refurbishments typically concentrate in September and October. Guests planning trips for late August often enjoy fuller ride lineups before maintenance windows begin.

topstories.title: September 16 Halloween party date sells out at Magic Kingdom
topstories.body: Disney confirmed another sold-out night for Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party. The mid-September date joins several others at capacity for 2026.

parkioInsight.text: Sold-out party nights close Magic Kingdom to regular guests at 6pm. Visitors without party tickets should plan to finish by early evening or park-hop to EPCOT, which typically stays open later.

topstories.title: Disneyland Plaza Inn character breakfast closure delayed one week to mid-August
topstories.body: The 1965 location will now close later than originally scheduled. Disney provided additional details on the refurbishment work planned for the Main Street restaurant.

parkioInsight.text: The extra week gives guests more time to book Minnie and Friends breakfast. Same-day walk-ups occasionally open after 9am, though reservations made in advance tend to secure preferred seating.

topstories.title: Disney and Starbucks unveil fall merchandise collection
topstories.body: The seasonal line debuted this week with tumblers, mugs, and accessories available at Starbucks locations inside Disney Springs and the parks. Items feature autumn and Halloween motifs.

parkioInsight.text: Seasonal Starbucks items often sell out quickly at Magic Kingdom's Main Street location. Disney Springs stores usually restock more frequently and offer better availability during peak hours.

icymi.title: Pocahontas-themed guest rooms revealed at Disney's Lakeshore Lodge
icymi.body: New murals showcasing the character now decorate renovated accommodations at the resort. The update is part of an ongoing character-inspired makeover across select Disney hotel properties.

icymi.title: Saratoga Springs restaurant closing in one month for refurbishment
icymi.body: A dining location at the resort will temporarily shut down in late August for renovations. Disney has not released a reopening date or details on the scope of work.

icymi.title: Behind the Attraction Season 3 now streaming on Disney Plus
icymi.body: The new episodes focus on Disney Cruise Line, exploring the storytelling and design behind the fleet. The two-part special is available to subscribers now.

spotlight.title: Cool Kids Summer hotel perks end soon at four Walt Disney World resorts
spotlight.body: Special welcome experiences and family amenities for young children continue through August at select Disney Resorts Collection properties. The seasonal program wraps as schools return to session.

parkioInsight.text: Families with preschoolers booking stays before late August may still access the program. Resort check-in tends to be faster on weekdays, leaving more time to explore pool areas and activities.
